correctness.rationale: The left and right actions each preserve n explicitly displayed three-dimensional endpoint spaces. Their matrices have ranks (2,1), (1,0), or (0,0) according to consecutive arrow support and the path-length-two coefficient. Summation gives every Jordan multiplicity. Cyclic support runs characterize all attainable (t,z). Transition weights separately count arrow and length-two coefficients, yielding the transfer polynomial. Coordinate-defined affine–torus pieces prove the motivic identity and dimensional formula. Actual independent matrix-rank enumeration passed eight finite-field cases, including GF(4); finite checks are not the proof.

value.rationale: The partition of nilpotent multiplication on the full regular module is a natural invariant refining nilpotency and square-zero counts. This theorem gives complete support, a sharp n-1 gap, exact binomial count of possible partitions, all finite-field multiplicities, all corresponding motivic classes and dimensions for every cycle length n>=3 and field. The result is a full classification over an unbounded algebra family, not a table recomputation or arbitrary numerical slice.
